claims.statement: Tom Allen received a letter from Charley Mitchell, dated London, Nov. 7, about Mitchell's coming fight with Corbett.
claims.excerpt: has received a characteristic letter from Charley Mitchell dated at London, Nov. 7.

claims.statement: Tom Allen was described as the noted retired champion pugilist of the world.
claims.excerpt: Tom Allen of this city, the noted retired champion pugilist of the world

notes: Mitchell's letter is quoted, but its words are about Mitchell's own fight and case, not about Allen, so they are not recorded as quotes.
